attributes.name: call-to-action element type
attributes.definition: The HTML element/semantic type used to implement calls to action and primary interactive items.

values.definition: CTAs and interactive items are links (anchor elements) rather than buttons.
CTAs are implemented as button elements.
Both anchors and buttons used substantially.
No calls to action or interactive items.

attributes.name: call-to-action visual style
attributes.definition: How calls to action are visually presented.

values.definition: Bold or accent-colored text link ending in an arrow glyph, no button chrome.
Boxed button appearance with fill or border.
Unadorned text link without arrow or button chrome.

attributes.name: interaction animation mechanism
attributes.definition: The CSS mechanism used to implement interactive state changes and motion.

values.definition: Hover/state changes use CSS transitions only.
Uses CSS animations or transforms for motion.
